description: This file defines a PHP class 'Filter' used for constructing SQL WHERE clauses based on filter parameters, including handling different operators and custom fields within a repository layer of an API module.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class for parsing filter parameters into SQL WHERE clauses, supporting multiple operators and custom fields, with validation for operators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Filter with a database manager instance.

methods.name: parseWhere
methods.description: Parses input parameters into a SQL WHERE clause based on filter conditions, handling operators, custom fields, and deletion status.

methods.name: addDeletedParameter
methods.description: Adds a default 'deleted' parameter to filter array (marked as deprecated).

methods.name: checkOperator
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a recognized constant. Throws exception if invalid.
